item.title: September 12, 2026 - New horizons
item.description: Page 266. "My life is well-rounded and I am becoming a more comfortable version of myself, not the neurotic, boring person that I thought I'd be without drugs." Just for Today: I can live a well-rounded, comfortable life--a life I never dreamed existed. Recovery has opened new horizons to me and equipped me to explore them.
